trap.label: Aim / to
trap.wrong: The aim is build mutual understanding.
trap.right: The aim is to build mutual understanding.
trap.why: O português diz “o objetivo é construir”, sem preposição. Em inglês, após The aim is, use to + base.

mcq.q: The aim ___ to open a library.

fix.wrong: The aim is open a clinic.
fix.right: The aim is to open a clinic.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “We want to open a clinic.” (The aim…)
rewrite.answer: The aim is to open a clinic.
